title: backlog.py check counts a touch's file as gone only when the integration main's history has it, not a work branch's own add and remove
goal: backlog.py check's moved-or-deleted touch rule counts a path as gone only when the integration main's history (origin/main, HEAD where there is no such ref) has it, not a work branch's own add and remove of it, so an item whose touch names a file that a branch added and removed before it reached main is no error at the landing gate

clauses.clause: backlog.py check's moved-or-deleted touch rule counts a path as gone only when the integration main's history (origin/main, HEAD where there is no such ref) has it, not a work branch's own add and remove of it, so an item whose touch names a file that a branch added and removed before it reached main is no error at the landing gate

gates.question: Which history makes a touch's file gone for check's moved-or-deleted rule: the integration main's only (HEAD's where no such ref exists), or HEAD's with the commits only the current branch holds left out?
options: the integration main's history only, HEAD's where no such ref exists
HEAD's history less the commits only the current branch holds
gates.recommendation: the integration main's history only, HEAD's where no such ref exists
gates.answer: the integration main's history only, HEAD's where no such ref exists

notes: Retrospective finding of SP-uwkr7iyl close, 2026-10-10: ST-w3jhowin's branch added and removed a test file before it reached main, and check refused 12 items in four sprints at the landing gate until the orchestrator repointed their touches by hand. Premise run 2026-10-12 on a planted repo: a path added and removed on a work branch is found by git log -1 HEAD -- PATH (bl_plan.stale_touches reads HEAD) and not by git log -1 main -- PATH, so the rule fires on the branch and not on main. Planned at the 2026-10-12 draft triage (sprint 16 of 19, "Land snags: gate answers committed by the tool, link touches, stale-touch reads, generated coverage files and the undelivered warning"): it fixes a failure that recurred in recent sprints and blocks the EP-gzr4mmkm fitness test that a content sprint lands on headless Sonnet workers with no operator step beyond its gates.
